cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Mum found the surprise-party invitations. Right on schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me hide them in my sock drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. She had to feel she'd uncovered it herself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. She hates surprises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's her part of the plan: taking control. We surprise her with how completely we obey.

mechanism: A treats its pupil concealment and obedience as parts of an allegedly planned party reversal, incorporating cancellation as the intended transfer of control.
confusable: Not claiming a bad event teaches a lesson: A insists the external scheme itself is on schedule while grading B limited understanding.
comparison: Contest escape versus family surprise-plan collapse.
